name: StarChip multiplier
author: DecompRecomp
description: Multiplies the StarChips awarded after a won Free Duel or campaign duel. The stars on the results screen stay at the retail count; only the balance added to the save is scaled (still capped at 999999).

settings.label: Multiplier
settings.description: How many times the retail prize (1 to 5 StarChips from the duel rank) is added to the save.
